name: Almdorf Ochsengarten
beschreibung: The Almdorf Ochsengarten is a holiday village nestled at around 1,500 meters above the Pitztal valley. The individual chalet-style cabins, built in traditional timber construction, each accommodate up to ten people and feature amenities such as a sauna, fireplace, and a fully equipped kitchen. Its location right next to the ski slope and cross-country skiing trail ensures direct access to winter sports activities. In summer, the surrounding forests and alpine pastures serve as perfect starting points for hiking and mountain biking tours. The village includes its own parking area and a children’s playground. The nearest shopping facilities are located in Ochsengarten, just two kilometers away. On-site dining is available within the village.
